characterization_methods: Linear polarized PL with photoelastic modulator (PEM) and polarizer
evidence: Transmission electron microscopy images reveal that we obtain a uniform short-range superlattice period... The TSL PL peak position allows us to extract the amount of MnTe grown in a TSLs period... Linear polarized PL has been detected with a photoelastic modulator (PEM) followed by a polarizer with the optical axes oriented at 45" to each other... The incident laser beam is also mechanically chopped (at about 100 Hz).
